events.text: Medication reports, notes and readings. One timeline.
Filter to the details you need.
Keep the checked instructions and schedule together.
Record the reported dose, then review and confirm.
A reminder alone never counts as a taken dose.
Capture a care note in their own words.
Nothing is saved until you review and confirm.
Choose exactly who can see the note.
Keep the next steps from the care plan in view.
Record an arranged visit and its appointment date.
Ask someone in your care circle for practical help.
Review the request and recipient before sending.
Bring the relevant care history to the next appointment.
Review the draft. Every item keeps its source.
Share a read-only copy after your review.
The same care record, ready on your phone.
